residentialHousehold.message: ₹26,000/kW is a maximum. The state subsidy is the lower of (DISCOM trusteeship-model bid cost minus PM Surya Ghar subsidy) or ₹26,000 × plant capacity in kW, capped at ₹78,000. No additional state subsidy above 3 kW.

ghsRwaCommonFacilities.message: ₹11,000/kWp, up to 500 kWp at 3 kWp per house, capped at the differential of total plant cost/kW and PM Surya Ghar subsidy/kW as discovered through bidding.

note: State benefits are additional to eligible central CFA, subject to scheme/policy conditions and current portal rules.

marketCostGuidance.message: Use as dated Delhi Solar Portal guidance only. Actual installer quotes and system specifications vary.
